answers.text: Pregnancy Category A drugs are the safest medication during pregnancy. If taken as directed, they should have no adverse effect on the growing foetus

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: NO, this statement is incorrect. Drugs that are in the Australian Pregnancy Category B have not had adequate research to determine whether they will ultimately be a pregnancy category A or C. The group is divided into Category B1, B2 and B3, depending on what the preliminary animal studies have shown. B1 drugs seem to be about as safe in animals as a pregnancy category A drug is in humans, while animal studies on Pregnancy category B3 drugs have seen some adverse effects in those unborn animals.

answers.text: Pregnancy Category B drugs are a bit safer during pregnancy than Pregnancy Category C drugs and can cause more problems to the growing foetus than Pregnancy Category A drugs

Pregnancy Category D Drugs cause harm to the growing foetus, although that harm does not include teratogenic changes. Teratogens are substances that cause congenital disorders in a developing embryo or foetus.
Pregnancy Category X drugs are teratogenic and should not be given to a pregnant woman or even a woman of child bearing years.
